rows.description: US Government official website banner with flag icon on left, 'Here's how you know' expandable, and red 'Veterans Crisis Line' banner on right
VA logo and seal with 'U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs' text on left; Search (with dropdown chevron), Contact us link, and Sign in button on right. Dark blue background.
Main navigation bar: 'VA Benefits and Health Care' (dropdown), 'About VA' (dropdown), 'Find a VA Location' (link), 'My VA' (link), 'My HealtheVet' (link). Lighter blue background.

notes: Row 0 is the standard US government website banner with Veterans Crisis Line CTA on right side
Row 1 contains the VA brand identity and utility links (search, contact, sign in)
Row 2 contains the primary navigation with 2 dropdown menus and 3 direct links
There is also a sticky PACT Act banner at the bottom of the viewport but this is a separate page element, not part of the header
